tasks.label: Travelly: Review Writer
tasks.command: Start-Sleep -Seconds 4; if (Get-CimInstance Win32_Process | Where-Object { $_.Name -eq 'python.exe' -and $_.CommandLine -like '*app.services.review_writer*' }) { 'Review writer is already running.' } else { & '${workspaceFolder}\.venv\Scripts\python.exe' -m app.services.review_writer }

tasks.label: Travelly: Backend
tasks.command: Start-Sleep -Seconds 6; if (Get-NetTCPConnection -State Listen -LocalPort 8000 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { 'Backend is already running on port 8000.' } else { & '${workspaceFolder}\.venv\Scripts\python.exe' -m uvicorn app.main:app --app-dir Backend --reload --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000 }

tasks.label: Travelly: Frontend
tasks.command: if (Get-NetTCPConnection -State Listen -LocalPort 5173 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { 'Frontend is already running. Open: http://localhost:5173/' } else { npm.cmd run dev }

tasks.label: Travelly: ngrok (PayHere)
tasks.command: Start-Sleep -Seconds 10; $line = Get-Content 'Backend\.env' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_ -match '^PUBLIC_API_URL=https://' } | Select-Object -First 1; if (-not $line) { 'ngrok not started: PayHere testing is off (no PUBLIC_API_URL=https://... in Backend\.env). This is fine for normal work.' } elseif (-not (Get-Command ngrok -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) { 'ngrok not started: ngrok is not installed.' } elseif (Get-Process ngrok -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { 'ngrok is already running.' } else { $domain = ($line -replace '^PUBLIC_API_URL=https://', '').Trim().TrimEnd('/'); ngrok http --url=$domain 8000 }
